title: Sr. Data Engineer (MS Fabric) (9 Months Contract)
description:
Sr. Data Engineer: The Sr. Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and delivering enterprise data solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role combines hands-on technical expertise in Azure data services with strong collaboration, data governance awareness, and delivery ownership. You will build and support Azure-based data platforms, ensure scalable and secure architecture, and work cross-functionally to deliver high-impact analytics and reporting solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Azure Data Solution Delivery Own the end-to-end build of Azure-based data pipelines and solutions, from design through deployment and support. Design and implement scalable data solutions by inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data structures. Apply strong hands-on expertise in Azure cloud services, SQL, integration toolsets, and Power BI. Develop, deliver, and document data management and BI solutions, including analytics, reporting, and dashboards. Monitor and optimize BI tools and data integrations to ensure high performance and reliability. Ensure on-time, high-quality delivery aligned with defined standards and business expectations. Collaborate with architecture and solution delivery teams to build sustainable BI and data applications with long-term business value. Support enterprise data storage and integration solutions, including databases, data warehouses, and BI platforms. 
 2. Azure Technical Expertise Build and implement solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance, Fabric & Power BI. Apply best practices in data modeling (star/snowflake schema), ETL/ELT design, performance optimization, and CI/CD for data pipelines (Azure DevOps). 
 3. Stakeholder & Business Engagement Translate business requirements into scalable and secure Azure data solutions. Collect, analyze, and document data requirements, producing conceptual and technical design documentation. Participate in discovery sessions and requirements workshops using interviews, process analysis, use cases, workflow modeling, and stakeholder discussions. Provide regular delivery updates and status reporting to project leads. Align data solutions with enterprise architecture and cloud strategy. Identify opportunities to enhance business value through advanced analytics and data insights. 
 4. Governance, Security & Compliance Implement Azure data governance, security, and compliance practices. Ensure adherence to PII regulations and enterprise data protection policies. Support data quality monitoring and validation processes. Maintain data dictionary, data mapping, lineage documentation, and transformation logic with strong attention to data integrity and accuracy. 
 5. Collaboration & Best Practices Deliver BI metrics, reports, data conversions, and transformation solutions. Participate in Agile ceremonies and sprint planning activities. Share knowledge with team members and follow standard operating procedures and best practices. Collaborate with third-party vendors as needed to support delivery. 
 Requirements & Skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 610 years of experience with Microsoft Data Platforms, including SQL Server Databases, Reporting platforms, ETL, and T-SQL. 610 years of experience working in Agile environments, Azure Cloud, and Azure Data Warehousing solutions. 6+ years of experience in data ingestion, processing, transformation, and publishing methodologies. Strong understanding of data engineering principles, architecture patterns, and best practices. Expertise in data modeling techniques (normalized, dimensional, star, snowflake schemas). Deep understanding of RDBMS operations and SQL Server performance optimization. Experience extracting and integrating data from structured (RDBMS) and unstructured sources (flat files, external feeds). Proficiency in query optimization, performance profiling, and monitoring tools. Experience creating and maintaining business requirements documentation and technical specifications. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Key Skills: Azure,Microsoft Fabric,Databricks,Data Platform,SQL,RDBMS,Microsoft Azure,Contracts

description:
Data Engineer - Python & MySQL 
 Department: Technology / Data & Analytics 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Experience Required: 3-7 Years Location: Remote 
We are looking for an AI-driven Data Engineer with strong expertise in Python, MySQL/SQL, ETL/ELT, and Data Pipelines to build reliable data solutions for Reports, Dashboards, and Analytics. The candidate will be responsible for extracting data from multiple sources, transforming and validating the data, and making it available in a structured and optimized format for reporting and analytics. The candidate should leverage AI tools and AI-assisted development to 
accelerate pipeline development, SQL generation/optimization, automation, troubleshooting, reporting, and documentation. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop automated ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL. Extract and transform data from databases, APIs, files, and multiple sources. Develop Python scripts for data extraction, transformation, and automation. Write complex and optimized SQL queries. Build optimized datasets for Power BI Reports and Dashboards. Implement data validation, quality checks, incremental loads, and scheduled processes. Use AI tools to accelerate coding, SQL optimization, debugging, automation, testing, and documentation. Identify opportunities to automate data engineering and reporting processes using AI. Troubleshoot pipeline and data quality issues. Coordinate cross-functional communication with Business, Product, and Analytics teams to align data engineering objectives with organizational goals. Maintain documentation for data pipelines and data sources. 
 Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in Python, MySQL, and SQL. Strong knowledge of MySQL and SQL Experience with ETL/ELT, Data Pipelines. Experience integrating APIs and multiple data sources. Hands-on experience with Power BI. Strong data transformation, validation, and problem-solving skills. Understanding of Dashboards, Reports, Data Models, Data Refresh, Data Visualization Experience using AI coding assistants / GenAI tools for development and automation. Ability to review, validate, and optimize AI-generated code and solutions.

Key Skills: Power BI,BI Tools,Business Intelligence Reporting,BI,Tableau,Data Analytics,Analytics,Python
